THE PRASHANSANEEYA SEVA VIBUSHANAYA AND THE PRASHANSANEEYA SEVA PADAKKAMA

IT is hereby notified that HIS EXCELLENCY THE PRESIDENT has been pleased to award the Prashansaneeya Seva Vibhushanayaand the Prashansaneeya Seva Padakkama to the Naval Personnel specified in the Schedule hereto.
B. M. U. D. BASNAYAKE,Secretary,Ministry of Defence.
